messages:
maria_ops: quick sync — onboarding weights for model `gpt-x-small-1`. HF source exists and we've got a mirrored s3 path, but local checksum disagrees with the manifest. did artifact-bot apply any post-upload transformations? :thinking:

sanjay: saw the mismatch earlier. artifact-bot ran the quantize step for the prod bundle (automatic when size > 6GB). that changes the tar checksum because we rewrite tensors. the manifest should have a separate field `derived_sha256` but i think it's missing for this model.

lia-eng: can you paste the HF URL and the s3 path so i can diff manifests quickly?

maria_ops: sure — HF: `https://huggingface.co/org/gpt-x-small-1/resolve/main/weights.tar.gz`
S3: `s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/gpt-x-small-1/20260312/weights.tar.gz`
manifest (from s3): `sha256: 7f3c4a2b...`

artifact-bot: uploaded `prod/gpt-x-small-1/20260312/weights.tar.gz` sha256=5a2b9f1c... derived=true quantized=true note="quantize-v2"

sanjay: yep, artifact-bot's `quantize-v2` rewrites internal layout which we intentionally do for lower memory serving. the HF upstream file will not match. we need two things: (1) manifest should list both `source_sha256` and `served_sha256`, (2) tokenizer+config validation should gate onboarding when they differ.

lia-eng: validator output i ran earlier: 
```
> model.json -> tokenizer_name = "gptx-tokenizer-v1"
> tokenizer.json -> vocab_size = 50258
> model_card.manifest -> served_sha256 = 5a2b9f1c...
> model_card.manifest -> source_sha256 = 7f3c4a2b...
> WARNING: tokenizer files differ from expected export. vocab_size mismatch (expected 50257)
```

lia-eng: the tokenizer mismatch is the risky bit — if vocab_size changed by 1 we can get off-by-one ids for special tokens. we should re-export tokenizer from the HF repo and ensure artifact-bot keeps the exact tokenizer bundle.

drew-ml: quick reproduce: i pulled the s3 weights and ran a sample decode, mostly fine, but emoji sequences break in some cases (multi-codepoint sequences get split). that smells like a tokenizer export/version mismatch.

maria_ops: for the immediate code review/qa session i need the presigned URL TTL extended. current dev flow gives 15m presigns which is too short for manual checks. can infra extend to 2h for this artifact (dev/external-review only)?

kevin-se: extending presign TTL is doable but cross-account security rules apply. for the `redwood-artifacts` bucket we require either a role assumption or a short-lived STS token to generate longer presigns. i can add a temporary role to the `eng-ml-reviewers` group. will follow up with a bucket policy snippet.

kevin-se: policy idea (sketch):
```
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:role/eng-ml-reviewers"},
  "Action": ["s3:GetObject"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-artifacts/prod/gpt-x-small-1/*"],
  "Condition": {"DateLessThan": {"aws:CurrentTime": "2026-03-13T12:00:00Z"}}
}
```

lia-eng: PR wise — i opened a tiny manifest schema bump: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/412 (adds `served_sha256`, `source_sha256`, `derived` flags). also added a validator error if tokenizer export differs.

sanjay: nice. once that merges artifact-bot needs a small change: publish both upstream SHA and served SHA into the manifest and attach `quantize_metadata` with `quantize-v2` + params. i'll open the artifact-bot patch.

artifact-bot: queued reupload job `job-9932` — will re-upload tokenizer bundle unmodified and write both sha fields once finished. ETA ~ 25m.

maria_ops: thanks — action items i have: 1) wait for artifact-bot reupload, 2) run validator against new manifest, 3) extend presign window for eng reviewers (kevin), 4) run emoji edge-case eval and report. i'll ping again after validator passes. :thumbsup:

drew-ml: i can run the emoji eval once you drop the new presign and manifest. i'll test 10k sample tokens + multi-codepoint emojis.

kevin-se: i'll create the temporary role and update bucket policy, will message infra-ops and paste policy changes in this thread when done.

maria_ops: perfect. cc @sanjay @lia-eng @drew-ml. thanks everyone — i'll close this loop when the validator is green.
